countryId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the country record from the countries collection. Identifies the player registered country.

username.description: Unique human-readable identifier given to the player. Used for login and player identification across the system.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, INR) defining the players wallet currency used for deposits, withdrawals, and gameplay.

playToken.description: Unique cryptographic token generated for the player to authenticate game sessions with integrated game providers.

totalBalance.description: Total monetary balance available in the players account, calculated as the sum of real, bonus, and any winnings-related balances.

realBalance.description: Amount of real, withdrawable money available in the players wallet.

bonusBalance.description: Amount of bonus funds received through promotions or rewards, subject to wagering rules.

totalDepositAmount.description: Cumulative amount of all successful deposits made by the player across their account lifetime.

totalWithdrawAmount.description: Cumulative amount of all completed withdrawals performed by the player.

totalWithdrawPendingAmount.description: Total amount currently under withdrawal processing or pending approval.

totalBonusCreditAmount.description: Total value of bonus money credited to the player.

totalRealBetAmount.description: Sum of all wager amounts placed using real funds.

totalRealWinAmount.description: Total winnings earned from bets placed with real balance.

totalBonusBetAmount.description: Sum of all wager amounts placed using bonus funds.

totalBonusWinAmount.description: Total winnings earned from bets placed with bonus balance.

totalDepositCount.description: Number of successful deposit transactions performed by the player.

totalWithdrawCount.description: Number of successful withdrawal transactions completed by the player.

totalRealBetCount.description: Count of individual bets placed using real money.

totalRealWinCount.description: Count of winning outcomes obtained from real-money bets.

totalBonusBetCount.description: Number of bets placed using bonus funds.

totalBonusWinCount.description: Number of winning outcomes obtained from bonus bets.

lastDepositAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the player last made a successful deposit.

lastWithdrawAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the player last completed a withdrawal.

email.description: Unique email address used for authentication, communication, and account recovery.

emailVerified.description: Boolean value indicating whether the player has verified their email through the verification process.

isConnectWallet.description: Indicates if the player has linked an external cryptocurrency wallet to their account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the player profile was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing the most recent update to the players document.

status.description: Overall account status: Pending, Active, Inactive, or Fraud.

bonusStatus.description: Indicates whether the player is eligible to receive bonus rewards. Can be enabled or disabled.

mailStatus.description: Controls whether marketing or system emails are enabled for the player.

smsStatus.description: Controls whether SMS notifications are enabled for the player.

i18n.description: Language preference code for user interface localization, using standard international language codes.

password.description: Securely hashed password string for login authentication.

salt.description: Random cryptographic salt used to hash the players password.

mobile.description: Players phone number used for communication, verification, and security notifications.

lastName.description: Players personal surname or family name.

gender.description: Gender identity of the player, used for demographic segmentation.

dob.description: Players date of birth, used for age verification and responsible gaming checks.

address.description: Primary residential address provided by the player.

address2.description: Secondary address line for additional address details.

state.description: State or province of the players registered address.

city.description: City of the players registered address.

pinCode.description: Postal or ZIP code of the players address.

resetPasswordToken.description: Token generated for password reset workflow, used once per reset attempt.

lastLoginDetails.description: Metadata about the players last login session, such as IP address,loginAt, userAgent, or timestamp.

isDepositLimitEnabled.description: Indicates whether responsible gaming deposit limit rules are active for this player.

depositLimit.description: Monetary limit imposed on how much the player can deposit within a specific timeframe.

depositLimitFrequency.description: Interval for deposit limit enforcement (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, etc.).

isBonusLimitEnabled.description: Indicates whether bonus usage limits are enforced for this player.

bonusLimit.description: Maximum amount of bonus funds the player is allowed to receive or use within a specified timeframe.

bonusLimitFrequency.description: Frequency interval for evaluating the players bonus limit.

playBalanceMode.description: Defines which balance types the player can use during gameplay: Real, Bonus, or All.

loyaltyPoints.description: Total loyalty reward points accumulated by the player from gameplay or promotions.

loyaltyLevelNumber.description: Numeric identifier of the players loyalty tier level.

loyaltyLevelName.description: Readable name of the players loyalty tier (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum).

affiliateId.description: ObjectId referencing the affiliate who referred the player, from the affiliates collection.

affiliateChannelId.description: ObjectId referencing the specific affiliate marketing channel that generated the player signup.

affiliateQueryParams.description: Raw tracking parameters captured during registration for affiliate attribution.

playerCategorizationId.description: Reference to the player categorization or segmentation profile used for behavior analysis.

kycRemarks.description: Comments or notes added by compliance/KYC officers during document review.

kycStatus.description: Overall KYC compliance status of the player (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Expired, NoKyc).

_id.description: Primary MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the player record.

__v.description: Internal document version number maintained by Mongoose for schema migrations.

name.description: Official country name used for player registration, regional configuration, and localization settings.

status.description: Operational status of the country within the platform. Determines whether the country is allowed for registration and gameplay. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive.

currencyCode.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, INR) representing the countrys primary monetary unit used for player transactions.

currencyName.description: Full name of the national currency used in the country, such as USD or Euro.

currencySymbol.description: Symbol representing the countrys currency (e.g., $, â‚¬, â‚¹), used for UI display and financial formatting.

countryCapital.description: Name of the capital city of the country, useful for metadata, location-based segmentation, or informational reference.

countryLanguage.description: Primary spoken language of the country in full language name form, used for localization defaults and culturally relevant content.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, IN, GB) used for compliance validation, geographic routing, and UI localization.

countryCodeAlpha3.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in extended format for standardized integrations.

countryIsoCode.description: Numeric ISO 3166 country code or standardized ISO identifier used in integrations and global data mappings.

countryLanguageCode.description: Short language code (e.g., en, fr, de, zh-CN) representing the default language for users from this country. Mapped to i18n system language codes.

phoneCode.description: International dialing prefix assigned to the country (e.g., +1, +44, +91), used for mobile number validation and formatting.

flagEmoji.description: Unicode emoji representing the country national flag, used for user interface display and visual selection inputs.

flagUrl.description: Direct URL pointing to the country flag image asset used in administrative dashboards or client UI applications.

timezone.description: Primary timezone identifier for the country (e.g., Asia/Kolkata, Europe/Paris), used for date-time normalization and user activity interpretation.

timezones.description: List of all supported timezone identifiers associated with the country, useful for countries spanning multiple zones.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the country record in the countries collection.

__v.description: Internal version number maintained by Mongoose for tracking schema revisions and document updates.

playerId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the country record from the countries collection. Identifies the player registered country.

countryId.description: Reference to the Country entity representing the player's registered geographical location.

masterProviderId.description: Reference to the master provider or gaming vendor associated with the transaction, primarily used for game transactions.

gameId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the game record from the games collection. Used in bet, win, rollback and gameplay-related reporting.

paymentGatewayId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing to Payment Gateway record from the paymentGateways collection. responsible for processing deposit or withdrawal operations.

auditId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Audit record from the audits collection, enabling compliance validation and reconciliation tracking.

couponId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Coupon record from the coupons collection, identifying the promotional voucher applied to the transaction.

affiliateId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Affiliate record from the affiliates collection, used for partner performance and revenue attribution.

affiliateChannelId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the AffiliateChannel record from the affiliateChannels collection, identifying the referral source that brought the player.

paymentMethod.description: Indicates the method used for payment processing such as Visa, MasteCard, Crypto, etc.

paymentVia.description: Additional payment source identifier describing the intermediate service or processing route.

paymentCryptoAddress.description: Wallet address used for cryptocurrency deposit or withdrawal processing.

cryptoNetwork.description: Blockchain network used for crypto payments (e.g., TRC20, ERC20, BEP20).

cardLastFourDigits.description: Masked representation of the card used for the transaction, storing only the last four digits for security.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the transaction event occurred, recorded in ISO format.

transactionHash.description: Unique identifier representing the transaction within the platform.

source.description: Defines the origin of the transaction such as Payment, Game, Admin, Affiliate, Kiosk, or Coupon operations.

type.description: Classifies the financial action involved: Deposit, Withdraw, Bet, Win, Credit, Debit, or Rollback.

amountType.description: Specifies whether the amount is Real, Bonus, or Mixed (Real_Bonus) balance.

status.description: Current processing state of the transaction such as Pending, Success, Failed, Cancelled, Refunded, or Chargeback.

amount.description: Monetary amount involved in the transaction, representing value credited or debited.

bonusName.description: Name or identifier of any bonus promotion associated with the transaction.

closingRealBalance.description: Final available real-money balance after processing the transaction.

closingBonusBalance.description: Final available bonus balance after processing the transaction.

playerCurrency.description: Currency code representing the player's default wallet configuration (e.g., USD, EUR, INR).

closingWinningBalance.description: Balance representing accumulated winnings after the transaction.

baseCurrencyAmount.description: Transaction value converted to system base currency which is EUR for analytics and reporting.

depositCurrency.description: Currency used for deposit when different from player's default currency.

depositCurrencyAmount.description: Amount received in the original deposit currency before conversion.

json.description: Raw transaction metadata or provider response stored for audit or debugging.

notes.description: Free-text remarks describing additional transaction details or administrative comments.

splitAmount.description: Breakdown of amount distributed across multiple balances such as Real and Bonus funds.

errorReason.description: Description of failure reason in case the transaction is rejected or unsuccessful.

ipAddress.description: IP address recorded at the time of the transaction, for security and fraud prevention.

device.description: Device type or user agent string representing the hardware used during the transaction.

rollbackTransactionId.description: Reference to the original transaction being reversed in case of rollback.

depositTransactionId.description: Reference to the deposit transaction related to subsequent bonus or credit rewards.

winningBetAmount.description: Original stake or wager amount associated with the winning outcome.

isFtd.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction represents the playerâ€™s first-ever deposit (First Time Deposit - FTD). Used for milestone tracking, promotional rewards, and affiliate attribution.

isQftd.description: Boolean flag marking whether the player qualifies as a 'Qualified First Time Depositor' (QFTD). This identifies genuine depositors who continue to play or engage beyond the first deposit, as opposed to users who make a single deposit and churn. Commonly used for affiliate deal validation and revenue-sharing qualification.

_id.description: Primary MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the transaction document.

__v.description: Document version key maintained internally by Mongoose.

name.description: Human-readable name of the payment gateway, displayed in dashboards and transaction processing modules.

processor.description: Processor identifier used to route payments through the correct integration service. Possible values: CapitalManagement, GateCharge, GumBallPay, UZOpay, PayTechno, QuantumPay, Payofix, BlockBee, SmilePayz, Pragmatic, BlockSystems, EzzyGate, FreedomPay, Slikair, Paysecure, Superbit, Cash, Neosurf, Paysafe, Finvert, Paydot, Paympire, AstroPay, KwidPay, PayPound.

depositorType.description: Defines the category of depositors supported by this gateway. Possible values: FTD (first-time depositors) and Recurring Depositors.

status.description: Operational status of the payment gateway. Determines whether it can be used by players. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive.

methods.description: Array of payment methods offered by the gateway. Each method specifies currencies, countries, crypto support, and fees.

rollingReservePercent.description: Percentage of settlement funds held temporarily as a reserve to cover potential chargebacks or disputes.

rollingReserveReturnDays.description: Number of days after which rolling reserve funds are released back to the settlement account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment gateway record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing the last update to the payment gateway record.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the payment gateway record in the PaymentGateways collection.

__v.description: Internal Mongoose version key for concurrency control and document versioning.

categorizationName.description: Human-readable name of the player category (e.g., 'VIP', 'High Roller', 'Newcomer'). Used to label and segment players based on predefined criteria.

categorizationLevel.description: Internal level or tier identifier for the category, used to rank or prioritize categories hierarchically within the platform.

categorizationColor.description: Hex code or color name representing the category visually in dashboards or UI displays for easy identification.

totalPlayers.description: Count of players currently assigned to this category. Automatically updated as players qualify or exit the category.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the player categorization record in the PlayerCategorization collection.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the player categorization record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the player categorization was created.

name.description: Official name of the provider, used for identification across the platform and visible in dashboards or game listings.

uniqueId.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the provider for internal referencing and integration purposes.

royaltyPercentage.description: Default royalty or revenue share percentage allocated to the provider from transactions, bets, or game revenue.

status.description: Operational status of the provider within the platform. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive. Determines availability of games or services from this provider.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the provider record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the provider record.

iconTheme.description: Preferred icon theme for the provider interface: Light, Dark, or Custom. Determines which icon variant is shown in the UI.

iconLightUrl.description: URL pointing to the provider's light-themed icon, used when UI theme is set to light.

iconDarkUrl.description: URL pointing to the provider's dark-themed icon, used when UI theme is set to dark.

iconCustomUrl.description: URL pointing to the provider's custom-themed icon, used if a custom branding theme is applied.

backgroundColor.description: Hex code or CSS color used for provider branding backgrounds in dashboards or game interfaces.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the provider record in the Providers collection.

__v.description: Internal Mongoose version key used for document versioning and concurrency control.

title.description: Official name of the tournament, used for display in dashboards, player interfaces, and reporting.

startDate.description: Date and time when the tournament begins. Used to control player participation and scheduling.

endDate.description: Date and time when the tournament ends. Determines when results are finalized and prizes are distributed.

status.description: Operational status of the tournament. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive. Determines visibility and eligibility for players.

categoryId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Category record in categories collection that classifies the tournament (e.g., game type or event type).

tournamentType.description: Type of tournament based on player activity: Deposit, Bet, or Win. Defines how points or scores are calculated.

description.description: Detailed description of the tournament rules, rewards, and conditions for player participation.

wagerToPointRatio.description: Conversion ratio between wagers (bets/deposits) and tournament points. Used to calculate leaderboard standings.

prizes.description: Array of prize objects specifying rank-based rewards. Each prize includes rank, amount, and its unique MongoDB _id.

imageUrl.description: URL pointing to the tournament banner or image, used in UI dashboards and promotional materials.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the tournament record in the Tournaments collection.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the tournament record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tournament record was created.

masterProviderId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the master provider that owns or manages this game globally across multiple providers.

providerId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Provider record for this specific game instance. Defines which provider supplies the game content.

categoryIds.description: Array of MongoDB ObjectIds referencing Category records. Used to classify the game into categories such as Slots, Live Casino, Table Games, Sports, etc.

name.description: Human-readable title of the game as displayed to players on UI and dashboards.

notes.description: Internal remarks or operational notes about the game for administrative usage, invisible to players.

status.description: Current operational availability of the game. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive. Determines player access and visibility.

launchUrl.description: URL used to launch the game client. Accessed by operators or players when gameplay is initiated.

imageUrl.description: URL for the game thumbnail or banner used in frontend display such as lobbies and recommendations.

imageAvailable.description: Boolean value indicating whether an image is available for the game. Used for fallback display handling.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing the creation date of the game record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing the last time the game record was updated.

sortDate.description: Date value used for sorting and prioritizing games based on relevance or recent updates.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the game in the Games collection.

name.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Slots, Roulette, Top Games). Used for UI grouping, filtering, and reporting.

index.description: Sorting order used to arrange categories visually in dashboards and gaming interfaces. Lower values appear first.

status.description: Operational state of the category. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive. Determines whether games under this category are displayed or hidden.

providerIds.description: List of MongoDB ObjectIds referencing Provider records associated with this category. Defines which providers contribute games to the category.

createdAt.description: Timestamp marking when the category was initially created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the category record.

campaignCommunicationId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing another Communication record in the same collection when this message is part of a campaign chain.

playerId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the Player to whom the communication is addressed.

masterAccountId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing the master/admin account that triggered or owns the communication.

type.description: Medium used for sending the communication. Allowed values: Mail or SMS.

status.description: State of the communication process. Possible values: Initiated, Success, or Failed.

isCampaign.description: Boolean indicating whether the communication is part of a promotional campaign or an individual message.

recipients.description: Array of recipient identifiers or contact values that the communication is sent to (e.g., email addresses or phone numbers).

email.description: Email address to which the message is sent, if communication type is Mail.

phone.description: Phone number to which the message is sent, if communication type is SMS.

subject.description: Title or subject line of the email or SMS message, used primarily for email communications.

content.description: Actual body text of the message delivered to the recipient(s).

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the communication was dispatched to the messaging provider.

response.description: Response returned from the email/SMS provider after sending, typically used for delivery validation.

error.description: Error message logged if sending fails, used for debugging and reporting.

selectedEmailId.description: MongoDB ObjectId referencing EmailCredential to determine which email configuration was used for sending.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the communication record.

__v.description: Mongoose internal version key for concurrency control and update tracking.

mailHost.description: Hostname or SMTP server address used for sending outbound emails (e.g., smtp.gmail.com, smtp.sendgrid.net).

mailPort.description: Port number used for SMTP communication. Common values include 465 for SSL and 587 for TLS.

mailStatus.description: Current operational state of the email configuration. Values: Pending, Active, Inactive.

mailTls.description: Boolean that determines whether TLS encryption is enabled for secure email transmission. Defaults to false.

mailSenderName.description: Display name shown as the sender when recipients receive the email (e.g., Casino Support).

mailSenderEmail.description: Email address used as the sending origin for outbound messages.

mailSenderPassword.description: Password or API key used for authentication with the SMTP mail server.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId uniquely identifying the EmailCredential record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the email credential record was last modified.

createdAt.description: Timestamp marking when the email credential record was initially created.

name.description: Display name used to identify the email template within admin dashboards and configuration screens.

htmlContent.description: HTML markup that defines the body of the email template, including placeholders for dynamic values.

type.description: Specifies whether the template is automatic system-generated (Automate) or custom-created by an admin (Custom). Default is Custom.

automateType.description: Indicates the automated email event type when type is Automate. Examples: Player_Register, Forgot_Password, Deposit_Success, Withdraw_Request.
